Suresh Sinha
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Koramangala, Bengaluru, India
suresh.sinha865@example.com | +91 9669707998

Experienced talent acquisition professional focused on closing mid-to-senior level roles in fast-paced product and engineering organizations. Strong track record of sourcing passive candidates, managing full-cycle Recruitment processes, and improving time-to-hire through targeted outreach and process optimizations. Available with a 30 days notice period.

Experience

Trellis Systems, Feb 2025 - Present
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Remote
- Led Talent Acquisition for a new engineering pod, sourcing and screening 45 candidates in 12 weeks using targeted Boolean searches and LinkedIn outreach, resulting in 6 hires across backend, frontend, and SRE roles and reducing time-to-fill by 22%.
- Managed full-cycle Recruitment for critical product roles, coordinated interview loops with hiring managers and Confluence-based scorecards, and improved offer acceptance rate to 87% through market insights and tailored compensation packaging.
- Built and maintained a candidate pipeline of 250+ qualified profiles using LinkedIn Recruiter campaigns and direct referrals, enabling 3 rapid hires within 2 weeks when urgent requisitions arose.

Zentrix Labs, Aug 2022 - Jan 2025
Recruiter | Hybrid
- Drove Talent Acquisition for data and platform teams, delivering 38 hires over 18 months by running high-conversion LinkedIn Recruiter campaigns and optimizing job descriptions to increase applicant quality by 30%.
- Reduced average time-to-hire from 56 to 40 days by designing standardized interview scorecards in Confluence and training hiring managers on structured feedback processes.
- Led passive candidate engagement; nurtured a network of 400+ potential hires and converted 12 passive prospects into hires through targeted messaging and role-fit conversations.

Dream11, Feb 2021 - Jul 2022
Talent Acquisition Specialist | On-site
- Managed end-to-end Recruitment for product and analytics roles, filling 25 positions in 16 months with a 82% offer acceptance rate by aligning role expectations and leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter for targeted sourcing.
- Partnered with engineering managers to define role competencies, created Confluence documentation for hiring rubrics, and implemented a referral incentive that increased qualified referrals by 40%.
- Conducted Linux-focused technical screen coordination for SRE and backend roles, ensuring technical assessments aligned with team requirements and improving first-round pass rates by 18%.

Projects
- Talent Pipeline Automation: Implemented a tagging and outreach cadence for passive candidates in LinkedIn Recruiter, increasing response rates by 35% and shortening outreach-to-screen time by 28%.
- Confluence Hiring Playbook: Authored a hiring playbook stored in Confluence for structured interviews and scorecards, adopted across three hiring teams to standardize evaluation and reduce bias.
